step: B (intends tier) and B2 (reasoning harvest spike)
rule: Floors are predeclared; a tier below its floor is reported, never retuned.

intentsTier.source: the live suite's epistemic tier filtered to tag 'intends' (liveReadTiers already carries tag/subject/content; the scorer needs an 'intents' tier that scores exactly those rows)
intentsTier.fixtures: at least 12 extractor fixtures with an 'expected.intents' list. Candidates: the 6 existing epistemic fixtures plus 6 new ones where a character states an aim in dialogue, 2 where only the player's narration implies one (must yield none), and 2 with meta-commentary in the reply

floors.expectCount: pinned to the fixture count when the fixtures land

intentsTier.deterministicHalf: src/memory/innerVoice.test.ts (evidence rule: player-attributed and meta-commentary dropped) and src/runtime/coordinators/innerVoiceInjection.review.test.ts

b2Harvest.switch: settings.memory.harvestReasoning = true (default absent = off, Resolved table)
b2Harvest.what: message.extra.reasoning of each character reply in the P2 window is fed to the epistemic pass as that character's own evidence for its [intends] lines (meta-commentary sentences removed first)
b2Harvest.procedure: on a Chat Completion profile that returns reasoning (plan 05 F7), replay the intents fixtures with extra.reasoning attached; score precision of intents whose only evidence is the reasoning, and the share of meta sentences ('I should write...', 'the user wants...') that never reach a row
b2Harvest.ifBelowFloor: recorded not built: the switch stays off and its settings key is removed
